title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream — Episode6 A Fun And Exciting PXL!

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Episode: Episode6 — A Fun And Exciting PXL!
meta.Event Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: A few days later
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Fun, fun PXL! Such a happy place♪
Boom, boom, boom! Here comes a big parade♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope Nene and Rui get here soon. We're gonna have sooo much fun today☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, you're here early.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Nene! Hi, Rui!
You're finally here! I've been waiting for ages!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, we're here ten minutes early...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, it's good to see that you're so excited.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because we have some good news to tell you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Good news?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <He's talking about us!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Rui and Nene told us what was going on, so we decided to join you guys! Let's do lots and lots of stuff together today☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! Miku and the others are here too!
This is so cool! It almost feels like my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I wish Tsukasa could also be here... It's too bad that he has to be in that show!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <*Gasp*>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wh-What do I do?!
I think I said too much!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm sure Tsukasa will be able to join us another time in the future...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
Two trips means twice the fun, right☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And I'm sure Tsukasa's doing his best right now to make sure he puts on a good performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, after Tsukasa does his show, we should come back again!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start going on some rides! Are there any that you guys wanna go on?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
About that...
I came up with a plan that should let us visit as many rides and attractions as we possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thanks, Rui! You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, get ready!
It's time to GO, GO, GO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <E-Emu, wait!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Geez...
She hasn't even heard your plan yet, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She seems happy on the surface, but she still seems partially preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I really hope this helps cheer her up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Whoa! Emu, this is so cool☆
The world's spinning round and round!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<This is fun!
Let's keep spinning faster and faster!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<What...? The drop's this high?
I need more time to mentally prepare...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Waaaahhhh!!!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whew...
All the rides we've been on so far have had big drops, but this train ride seems nice and gentle!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but the end of this one also...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Huh? No, don't tell me...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Again?! You've gotta be kidding me!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, we got to go on the three most popular rides in the park!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!
That was so much fun☆>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was fun... But...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If possible, I'd like it if we could go on something a little more gentle next...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What? I wanna keep going on the fun rides!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Me too!
The ones that go zing-zang-zoom!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<How are you guys okay?
My eyes won't stop spinning...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we've been at it for quite a while now, so it may be a good time to take a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm pretty tired after being flung around so much. A drink sounds nice right about now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go around to the spots where the shops are and take a look at each of them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The popcorn differs depending on where you buy it, so seeing what's available should be fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, is that true?!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, the popcorn here's really famous and comes in all sorts of different flavors♪ Everything from your classic salty butter to fizzy soda!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Soda popcorn...? I'm having a hard time imagining how that tastes, but it sounds very tasty, not to mention fizzy.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miku, since you and the others won't be able to have any right now, we'll buy some to bring back later. Let's walk around and see if any catch your eye.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, this will give us a chance to do a lap of the park.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A lap of the park...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then! Let's start with the closest one! It's over this way!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The soda-flavored popcorn looked really good. I can't wait for you guys to bring some over to SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And thank you for waiting in that long line to buy it.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No problem. Besides, we want all of you to try it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, there do seem to be more people visiting today compared to before...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, there are.
I saw a lot of people going to the other shop as well.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's just giant lines left and right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is it because today's a holiday?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That may be playing a role...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I think it's because the park is simply attracting more visitors...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: More visitors...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. More people began to visit after we put on more and more shows at the Wonder Stage... However, lately, something seems different about the park, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe we have our ambassadorial performances to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely! Keisuke and Shosuke even said how they really helped increase the park's attendance figures.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And that makes me really happy.
Bit by bit, it's feeling more like the park when Grandpa was still around.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree...
It's nice to see so many more smiling guests.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Now I get it...
This is why Rui wanted Emu to do this.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hey, you guys!
Can we check out the shop with the lemon-flavored popcorn?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I wanna see it too☆
What color do you think it's gonna be? The soda one was blue, so lemon means yellow, right?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, then... Let's head over that way since it might be less crowded. If I recall, it's just over that way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!
Thanks, Nene! Lead the way!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...? M-Me? Sure, but...
Rui, Emu, please tell me if I start going the wrong way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm sure you'll do an amazing job as our guide, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd rather not be put on a pedestal.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
This is great. Everyone's laughing and smiling.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Also, all the guests seem really happy. I'm really glad we're doing this...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If we keep doing more and more shows, and bringing more and more people to the park...)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Mommy!
I wanna go on that next!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Again?! We just went on it!
I guess it means you love it just that much. I feel like we go on it at least three times every time we come here, sweetie...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wait, do they mean...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The fish coaster?)
